USV Survey Characterizing Oceanographic Conditions To Inform Ecosystem Structure And Protected Species Habitat

The purpose of this survey is to characterize oceanographic conditions to inform ecosystem structure and protected species habitat near Nantucket Shoals in January 2026 using active acoustics and vertical casts of CTDs and particle imaging
